ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure, the wheel has a thin circular rim and a central black axle/axis point, and three orange spokes extend from the center: one points horizontally to the left, and the other two slant respectively to the upper right and lower right; the three spokes are separated by about 120°. Beside each spoke is labeled mass M, and the length marker R indicates the length of the spoke from the center to the rim. Reasoning: Each spoke is a uniform rod, with length R and mass M, so the weight Mg of each spoke acts at its midpoint, at a distance R/2 from the axis center. Take counterclockwise as positive, and use angles relative to the +x direction to represent the positions of the three spokes: the left spoke is 180°, the upper-right spoke is 60°, and the lower-right spoke is 300° (or -60°). Gravity is vertically downward, so the torque about the axis is τ_z = x F_y = -Mg · (R/2 cosθ). The total torque of the three spokes is: τ_net = -(MgR/2)[cos180° + cos60° + cos300°] = -(MgR/2)[-1 + 1/2 + 1/2] = 0. Therefore the net torque is 0.

Consider the counterclockwise direction to be positive. When the spokes are oriented as shown in the diagram above, what is the net torque on the wheel due to the weight of the spokes?

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as showing three spokes from the axle: one horizontal to the left, one slanting up-right, and one slanting down-right, separated by 120 degrees. From the text, each spoke is a uniform rod of length R and mass M, so each weight Mg acts downward at its midpoint, distance R/2 from the axle. Assign angles relative to +x as 180°, 60°, and 300° (or -60°). The torque from each weight about the axle is tau_z = x F_y = -Mg (R/2 cos theta), with counterclockwise positive. Sum the three torques: -(MgR/2)[cos180° + cos60° + cos300°] = -(MgR/2)[-1 + 1/2 + 1/2] = 0.

推理：每根辐条是均匀杆，长度为 R、质量为 M，因此每根辐条的重力 Mg 作用在其中点，距轴心 R/2。取逆时针为正，并用相对 +x 方向的角度表示三根辐条的位置：左方辐条为 180°，右上辐条为 60°，右下辐条为 300°（或 -60°）。重力竖直向下，所以对轴的力矩为 τ_z = x F_y = -Mg · (R/2 cosθ)。三根辐条的总力矩为：τ_net = -(MgR/2)[cos180° + cos60° + cos300°] = -(MgR/2)[-1 + 1/2 + 1/2] = 0。因此净力矩为 0。

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a three-spoke wheel with equal spokes arranged every 120 degrees around the axle, with the rim mass negligible. From the text, all three spokes have the same mass and uniform density, so each spoke’s center of mass lies halfway along its spoke. The three center-of-mass position vectors are equal in magnitude R/2 and separated by 120 degrees, so their vector sum is zero. Therefore the combined center of mass of the three spokes is exactly at the axle. Since gravity acts as a single total weight 3Mg through the system center of mass, its line of action passes through the axle and produces no net torque. Thus the net torque is 0.
